name: @pipeworx/mcp-fr-judilibre

tools.name: fr_judilibre_search
tools.description: Search French judicial decisions (Cour de cassation and the courts of appeal it indexes) published as open data: full-text `query` plus filters for jurisdiction, chamber, formation, decision type, theme, publication level and solution, paged. Returns decision ids, summaries and highlighted snippets; fr_judilibre_decision reads the full text. Codes like "cc" (jurisdiction) or "civ1" (chamber) resolve to French labels via fr_judilibre_taxonomy.

query.description: Full-text search terms, e.g. "responsabilité du fait des choses".

field.description: Restrict the full-text match to these decision zones, e.g. ["motivations","dispositif"]. Omit to search the whole decision.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction codes, e.g. "cc" (Cour de cassation), "ca" (cour d'appel). See fr_judilibre_taxonomy(id:"jurisdiction").

type.description: Decision type codes, e.g. "arret" (judgment), "qpc" (constitutionality question). See fr_judilibre_taxonomy(id:"type").

publication.description: Publication-level codes, e.g. "b" (Bulletin), "r" (Rapport). See fr_judilibre_taxonomy(id:"publication"). A decision with none of these is unpublished — most are.

date_start.description: Decision date range start, ISO YYYY-MM-DD.

date_end.description: Decision date range end, ISO YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: fr_judilibre_decision
tools.description: Read one French judicial decision by id (from fr_judilibre_search): full pseudonymised text, its structural zones (introduction/exposé/moyens/motivations/dispositif/annexes as character offsets into `text`), the texts it applies (`visa`, with best-effort `cited_articles` linking to @pipeworx/france-legi's code+article), related decisions (contested, forward, rapprochements) and attached files.

id.description: The decision id, from a fr_judilibre_search result.

resolve_references.description: When true, the source resolves linked decision/text references inline instead of leaving them as bare ids (default false).

tools.name: fr_judilibre_taxonomy
tools.description: Resolve the short codes fr_judilibre_search/fr_judilibre_decision use (jurisdiction, chamber, formation, type, solution, publication, theme) into their French labels, or the reverse (a label into its code). Pass no `id` to list the available taxonomy categories.

id.description: Taxonomy category, e.g. "jurisdiction", "chamber", "formation", "type", "solution", "publication", "theme". Omit to list the categories.

key.description: A code within `id` to resolve to its label, e.g. id:"jurisdiction", key:"cc" -> "Cour de cassation". Requires `id`.

value.description: A label within `id` to resolve back to its code (the reverse of `key`). Requires `id`.

context_value.description: Context needed by some categories — e.g. "chamber" only makes sense within a jurisdiction: context_value:"cc" for the Cour de cassation's chambers (the default), "ca" for a cour d'appel's.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-fr-judilibre forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the fr-judilibre pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
